Samantha — thanks for flagging. We will provide redacted runtime traces and the control-plane audit log for the requested window. A few notes:
- Retention: Hosted customers have 30-day runtime trace retention by default; enterprise customers can opt-in to longer retention. For FB-2025-ENP-47 our contract shows 90-day trace retention (see clause 3.2).
- Redaction: Our standard delivery is redacted traces (prompts/payloads masked) plus a verification manifest that shows hashing was applied (no mapping table will be provided unless you have a documented exception).
- Chain of custody: we'll provide a signed evidence bundle and a timestamped export (SHA256 manifest) for your reviewers.

ETA for redacted traces + audit log: by EOD Monday (Feb 16). If you need raw traces for an internal forensic audit, we need a written exception signed by FinBridge's DPO.

I'll prepare the legal cover note and attach the evidence bundle link when ready.

— Laura
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
